provenance.notes:
R6-03.GEN4 (h-banner): SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: an IRON BANNER standard — a riveted dark pole carrying a heavy cloth banner with the Sovereign sigil: an amber diamond with a lit heart, folds shifting, pennant edge at its right. The palette: citadel steel #8a8e98 #4a4e58 with hazard AMBER #e0a040 accents, dark iron #3c404a, near-black navy outline — the IRON CITADEL zone.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 2 equal square cells laid out as TWO cells in ONE row of TWO (2 columns by 1 row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom): the SAME subject, squarish (width close to height), centred in its cell at the same scale — ONLY the named state changes between cells; the silhouette stays identical in all cells.
  cell 1 = folds settled, pennant down; cell 2 = folds rippling, pennant lifting.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 40 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge (outline only around the bright core, fading out in the halo), no anti-aliasing, no motion blur. — the 2 cells cropped to their measured subject boxes with the 6-px key border clamped inside each cell; state xors 29.5% over the interim animation floor 2.34%. Owner ruling 2026-10-23, verbatim: "the images are fine to use... open source game... not commercial". Owner directive 2026-10-26, verbatim: "ai generate those other things too" — record line: owner directive 2026-10-26: picker gate waived for never-designed slots.
